en.title: Skånskanhuset sold for SEK 50 million: "Will be preserved"

Malmö cityfastigheter has bought the building for around SEK 50 million and is clear that the building will be preserved – not demolished like the neighbouring house. "Our business idea is to restore old houses to their former glory," says CEO Christoffer Persson.
